name: Conventional Commits
description: Validates that commit messages follow the conventional commits format (feat:, fix:, chore:, etc.)
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Validate conventional commit format
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit.*-m'; then
  MSG=$(echo "$COMMAND" | sed -n 's/.*-m ["'\''"]*\([^"'\''"]*\).*/\1/p')
  if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore|perf|ci|build|revert)(\(.+\))?!?:'; then
    echo "BLOCKED: Commit message must follow conventional commits format (e.g., feat: add feature)"
    exit 2
  fi
fi
exit 0
